title: the codemother verdict gate reads a validate berth recorded on another host through chain.resolve_berth
intention: The codemother verdict gate resolves the validate berth, and the hypothesize berth it names, recorded on another host through chain.resolve_berth, as sail.validate_path does, so a verdict run on a box other than the one that charted reads the commons copy instead of refusing.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendell (Windows): python cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py verdict 8e0cfb77827c -> the verdict gate refused: "[verdict] FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '\home\akien\.cairn\devices\chart\0\packets\validate-20261119T071409-86ddb12d17da.json'". Ticket 1e99a571dd6d fixed sail.verdict's lookup (sail.validate_path) but not the gate's: chart_gate/gate.py _dispose opens packet['validate_ref'] and validate['hypothesize_ref'] with Path(...).read_text. 8e0c is FIXME:waiting (trouble ticket-refused-8e0cfb77827c-at-verdict).
traces_to: Law 3 (a Windows verdict is the measurement the clause asks for) and Law 7 (an unresolvable ref still refuses loudly); siblings 1e99a571dd6d, d86b4e5ae614, 4e84a96955a1.
how: In chart_gate/gate.py _dispose open validate_ref and hypothesize_ref through chain.resolve_berth(ref) falling back to os.path.expanduser(ref), as verdict_contract._open_ref does; red-first proof as a fixture with a foreign-spelled recorded ref (PureWindowsPath and /home/akien/... forms) plus a commons copy, so it reds on Linux too; it lands alone on main before the chart.

clauses.claim: with a validate berth recorded at a foreign path absent here and its commons copy present, _dispose reads it and disposes instead of raising FileNotFoundError
the hypothesize berth named by that validate packet is likewise read through its commons copy
when neither the recorded path nor a commons copy exists, _dispose still raises FileNotFoundError naming the recorded path (Law 7)

decisions.text: D1: _dispose opens validate_ref and hypothesize_ref through chain.resolve_berth, falling back to the expanded recorded path so an unresolvable ref keeps its own error; the build also greps gate.py and verdict.py for any other direct open of a berth ref.
D2: the red-first proof is a fixture (foreign-spelled ref plus a commons copy), one tooth per clause, PROVES declared.
